scope: Actual appearance evidence with compatibility for old incomplete participant lists
Complete long-entry scans with accurate pre-confirmation batch counts
Scan origin and cancellation ownership isolation, including late cleanup
History, nested past-life references, page fallbacks, song-list and single-name labels

verification.rebuild: python3 tools/verification/build.py . --sync-release-notes; then --check; full suite independently builds twice to temporary files and compares bytes
verification.version_identity: manifest, index, runtime and selfUpdater checked

red_green.result: new tests run against pinned r12 sources: 0/10 passed; candidate: 10/10

red_green.case: old scan cleanup detaches a replacement scan listener
red_green.result: new regression failed before fix; passed after fix for both late resolve and reject

verification.production_diff: git diff --check passed; existing tests retained
verification.koori_preservation: Original localArchive, localArchiveAuto, settings, heartbeatMemories, overlayClickActions and overlayCore are unchanged versus Koori HEAD. All other common source files match standard except the selfUpdater build identity.
verification.review: Separate scoped reviewers checked appearance and scan/alias/cancellation paths. Issues found were reproduced and corrected; not a repository-wide security scan.

packaging.final_zip: CRC, SHA-256, path/root checks and full tests are repeated from freshly extracted final packages; ZIP self-hash is not embedded in itself.

limitations: Legacy free-text appearance inference is heuristic; it cannot guarantee arbitrary natural-language interpretation or repair inaccurate existing participant records.
No real model/provider requests, Chromium/host DOM, native IndexedDB, TT, iPhone or co-installed SillyTavern tests were executed.
Abort requests are sent locally; actual provider billing or cancellation cannot be guaranteed by these mocked tests.
Full scans can use more explicitly confirmed batches than the old truncated scans. No unconfirmed automatic requests or new generation limits were added.
TT sticker persistence acknowledgement remains a device-verification item; save logic was not changed in this patch.
data_preservation: No rewrite or migration of existing archives, settings snapshots or generated content; no deletion of original packages.

syntax.method: vm.SourceTextModule parse of all JS/MJS files
